content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Columbus

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional hours of documented PM work. Review PMI's specific education and experience thresholds—our advisors can help you verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions on a schedule that fits your work at Fort Moore, Aflac, Synovus, or elsewhere across Columbus's military, financial services, healthcare, and advanced-manufacturing sectors. Full coursework equips you with the knowledge PMI expects.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, create your PMI application account, upload proof of education and project experience, and pay the PMI exam fee. Our team provides guidance on documentation requirements so your application moves through PMI's review process without delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials, practice tests, and instructor feedback to solidify your readiness. When you're confident, schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE center or sit for it online. We remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, you'll need to earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and resources to help you meet PMI's maintenance requirements and advance your career in Columbus's growing project-management landscape.
